## TemplateEngine.MAX\_PAID\_MEDIA\_STARS property

Maximum Stars price for a `<g-paid-media>` paywall.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static MAX_PAID_MEDIA_STARS: number;
```

## Remarks

The Bot API `sendPaidMedia` `star_count` accepts 1–25000 Stars per purchase (source: `https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendpaidmedia`<!-- -->). Static values above this are rejected at validation time; compiled values are re-checked at runtime by `Ctx.assertPaidMedia`<!-- -->.
